home_title: The funny things your friends say, kept somewhere safe.
home_intro: Make a group, share the link, and let everyone add the quotes worth remembering. No accounts needed - everything lives in this browser unless you choose to sync it.
home_empty: You haven't joined any groups on this device yet. Create one, or join an existing group with a link.
home_openGroupPlaceholder: Leave blank for an open group
home_linkPlaceholder: Paste the link a friend sent you
home_nameRequired: Give your group a name first.
home_linkRequired: Paste the group link or ID you were given.
home_notFound: That group doesn't exist. Check the link.
account_intro: By default your groups only live in this browser. Create a small password-protected account to back up and sync the list of groups you belong to - the quotes themselves always stay on the server, this just syncs which groups this device knows about.
group_checkLink: Double check the link, or head back home.
group_leaveConfirm: Remove "{name}" from this device? The group and its quotes stay online.
group_quotePlaceholder: I'm not saying it was aliens, but it was aliens.
group_personPlaceholder: Start typing a name, or leave empty for someone...
group_dateTimeInvalid: Choose a valid date and time.
group_noQuotes: No quotes yet. Be the first to add one above.
